#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

string s;

string f() {
    // Replace first "at" from index 1 onward
    size_t pos = s.find("at", 1);
    if (pos != string::npos && pos >= 1 && pos + 1 < s.size()) {
        s.replace(pos, 2, "@");
    }
    // Replace all "dot" from index 1 onward
    pos = s.find("dot", 1);
    while (pos != string::npos && pos >= 1 && pos + 2 < s.size()) {
        s.replace(pos, 3, ".");
        pos = s.find("dot", pos + 1); // start after the inserted "."
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    while (cin >> s) {
        cout << f() << endl;
    }
}

    // Replace first "at" from index 1 onward using iterators
    auto it = s.begin() + 1;
    while (it + 1 < s.end()) {
        if (*it == 'a' && *(it + 1) == 't') {
            it = s.erase(it, it + 2);
            it = s.insert(it, '@');
            break;
        }
        ++it;
    }
    // Replace all "dot" from index 1 onward
    it = s.begin() + 1;
    while (it + 2 < s.end()) {
        if (*it == 'd' && *(it + 1) == 'o' && *(it + 2) == 't') {
            it = s.erase(it, it + 3);
            it = s.insert(it, '.');
            // After insertion, move past the inserted '.' to avoid re-scanning
            ++it;
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    return s;
}

    while (cin >> s) {
        cout << f() << endl;
    }

    // Replace first "at" from index 1 onward using regex
    // We need to ensure we only replace the first occurrence starting at position >=1
    // Use regex_search to find the first match starting at position 1
    regex at_re("at");
    smatch match;
    string temp = s.substr(1); // consider substring from index 1
    if (regex_search(temp, match, at_re)) {
        size_t pos = 1 + match.position();
        s.replace(pos, 2, "@");
    }
    // Replace all "dot" from index 1 onward
    regex dot_re("dot");
    string suffix = s.substr(1);
    string replaced = regex_replace(suffix, dot_re, ".");
    s = s.substr(0, 1) + replaced;
    return s;
}

int main() {
    while (cin >> s) {
        cout << f() << endl;
    }
